headline: Sensex gains 100 points and Nifty tops 23,300 driven by lower crude prices and financial gainers

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Sensex and Nifty rebounded as easing crude oil prices lifted investor sentiment.
Gains in major financial heavyweights like Kotak Mahindra Bank and Bajaj Finance supported the benchmark indices.
Indian markets opened positive despite geopolitical concerns in the Middle East and FII outflows.
Mixed Asian market signals and Gift Nifty trends influenced early morning trade.
whatHappening: Arvind SmartSpaces shares surged 12% in morning trade.
Prime Focus-backed Brahma AI raised $150 million at a $2 billion valuation.
Gold prices dropped Rs 1,900 per 10 grams, while silver rose Rs 1,400 per kg.
Rajesh Exports listed among Nifty 500 stocks that tumbled sharply in 2026.
summary:
Indian stock markets traded higher on September 23, with the Sensex gaining 100 points and Nifty crossing 23,300.
Easing crude oil prices provided support alongside gains in Kotak Mahindra Bank and Bajaj Finance.
Individual stock highlights included a 12% jump in Arvind SmartSpaces and funding news from Prime Focus-backed Brahma AI.
